bill.title: A bill to establish consumer transparency and protection requirements for artificial intelligence chatbots, and for other purposes.
bill.latestActionText: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

classification.plainSummary: This bill would require companies that operate AI chatbots to disclose to users when they are interacting with artificial intelligence rather than a human. It would establish transparency requirements so consumers know they are communicating with an automated system. The bill would also create consumer protection standards for how AI chatbots operate and interact with the public.

industries.rationale: The bill directly regulates AI chatbot operators, imposing new disclosure and transparency obligations on software and internet platform companies that deploy these systems.
Retailers and e-commerce platforms that use AI chatbots for customer service would face new compliance requirements for disclosing automated interactions.
Banks and financial services firms that deploy AI chatbots for customer support or account services would need to meet the new transparency standards.
Telecom and cable providers that use AI chatbots for customer service interactions would be subject to the disclosure requirements.
